gaps.quote: two equal address fields of width $u$

gaps.note: 'Unit volume' is not defined or linked here, so the reader cannot tell what per-unit-volume cost means.

gaps.quote: This is what lets a recursive scheme pay less per edge when its parameter shrinks
gaps.note: The page does not say what the recursive scheme is, what its parameter is, or how it is shrunk, and does not link to a page that does.

gaps.term: smaller operations and the cost link
gaps.quote: the drop in dimension across an edge counts the smaller operations that edge needs
gaps.note: 'Smaller operation' is never defined, and the page gives no argument why the dimension drop equals the number of such operations on an edge. The example's conclusion 'so the edge needs one smaller operation' rests on this unexplained identification.

gaps.note: The page presents the labels as supporting a cost bound (less than linear in u per unit volume) but gives no computation or argument connecting the labels to that bound, so the reader cannot check it.

gaps.note: The page asserts that frame changes cancel between the two ends of a route but does not say what a route is in this setting or why the cancellation holds.

gaps.note: 'Gather and scatter wires' are not defined or linked; the reader cannot tell how they produce intersection-dependent coefficients. The linked subset-intersection network page is followable, but this claim about its wires is not explained on this page.
